Title: Rishabh's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Rishabh - 9 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Hema - 42 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Kunal - 11 years, friend
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
4. Siya - 13 years, daughter
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The snowy hillside - white snow, deodar trees
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Rishabh stands in the courtyard. Hema and Kunal stand near him.]

Kunal: "What lovely weather!"

[A storm breaks over the village.]

Rishabh (happily): "How beautiful!"

[Thunder rumbles in the distance.]

Rishabh: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Snow begins to fall.]

Rishabh (surprised): "How beautiful!"

[Hailstones start falling.]

Kunal (gently): "Really?"

[Thick fog covers the village.]

Rishabh: "How beautiful!"

Scene 2: The snowy hillside - Day

[Rishabh stands in the snow. Hema stands near him.]

Hema: "Let's begin."

[Rishabh makes a snowball and throws it at Mother.]

Rishabh: "Really?"

[Rishabh builds a snowman.]

Rishabh: "What happened?"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

Kunal: "What a nice place."

[Rishabh sweeps the floor with a broom.]

Hema (gently): "Show me too!"

[Rishabh mops the floor.]

Rishabh: "And then?"

[Rishabh irons his school shirt.]

Rishabh (excited): "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
